import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,base64,sys,json,re
L=Path.cwd()
for name,p in [('forest',1),('cactus',3)]:
 r=subprocess.run(['pdftoppm','-f',str(p),'-l',str(p),'-scale-to','1800','-singlefile','-png',str(L/('sources/'+name+'.pdf'))],capture_output=True);assert r.returncode==0
 q=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(L/'write_lane.py'),f'visual/{name}-{p}.png','--base64'],input=base64.b64encode(r.stdout),capture_output=True);assert q.returncode==0
print('r1 recovery [3500,6500)');print(Path('inputs/review-r1-REVIEW.md').read_text()[3500:6500])
for n in ['search/full-one.json','search/full-two.json']:
 x=json.loads(Path(n).read_text());print(n,type(x).__name__,len(x),repr(x[:80]),repr(x[-80:]))
print('OWN FILES', '\n'.join(str(p.relative_to(L)) for p in L.rglob('*') if p.is_file() and 'inputs' not in p.relative_to(L).parts))
